nodes.label: Privacy and persistence
nodes.description: Current storage is browser-local; multi-device or shared storage requires an actual service.

nodes.label: Folio product
nodes.description: Document management product governed by durable user-centered design principles.

nodes.label: Recover from mistakes
nodes.description: Explain destructive actions, confirm when appropriate, and undo when possible.

nodes.label: Accessible responsive use
nodes.description: Keep keyboard shortcuts and small-screen layouts; do not require a mouse.

nodes.label: Find and recover documents
nodes.description: Maximum-priority job: immediate search by name and useful format/date filters.

nodes.label: Measure and validate
nodes.description: Measure search effort, successful persistent uploads, action errors/recovery, and use of filters and batch actions.

nodes.label: Complete action feedback
nodes.description: Persist changes, report the result, and update the visible interface; do not fake working actions.

nodes.label: Primary user outcome
nodes.description: Save a document, find it when needed, and understand consequences before changing it.

nodes.label: Batch organization
nodes.description: Select multiple documents and move or manage them with the destination visible.

nodes.label: Recognize before acting
nodes.description: Show document type, size, date, and preview when supported.

nodes.label: Save documents confidently
nodes.description: Upload through picker or drag and drop; show destination and result; survive reload.

nodes.label: Vuetify interaction patterns
nodes.description: Use menus for contextual actions, dialogs for decisions, chips for filters, tooltips for unlabeled icons, and snackbars for brief feedback.
